_comment: wave 35: the single-sequence trgeometry accessors trgeometry_start_sequence / trgeometry_end_sequence. They reuse the wave-34 tpose windowed builder (collect (x,y,theta,ts) -> [Pose(Point(x y),theta)@ts,...] -> tpose_in -> geo_tpose_to_trgeometry(unit-square ref) -> accessor) but the accessor returns a SINGLE Temporal* (TSequence*), not a T**+&_cnt array, so they use the new fold tposeseq1 (one result -> EWKB hex, no array loop). trgeometry_sequence_n is deferred: it needs a scalar int index threaded into the aggregation descriptor (no field), which the windowed-aggregation framework does not yet carry.

operators.comment_one_liner: trgeometry_start_sequence (TSequence *) - the first sequence of the windowed continuous trgeometry, as EWKB hex.
trgeometry_end_sequence (TSequence *) - the last sequence of the windowed continuous trgeometry, as EWKB hex.
